items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account, gaining access to the victim's account and private data. Exploitation requires no existing account, administrator privileges, or user interaction.

items.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, application denial-of-service, privilege escalation, arbitrary code execution, and arbitrary file system read.

items.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary Code Execution via Webhooks
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) in the webhooks component allows unauthenticated, zero-interaction arbitrary code execution due to improper output encoding. Adobe released an isolated patch alongside the full release.

items.id: Amasty Extensions (no specific CVEs provided in source)
items.title: Amasty patches dozens of Magento extensions, including two critical RCE flaws
items.summary: Amasty issued a massive security release for dozens of its Magento extensions, addressing two critical vulnerabilities that could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes (CVE-2026-53787) allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, opening the door to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated Unrestricted File Upload in Magento REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store using a polyglot technique to bypass validation. Attacks have been observed against a high percentage of stores.

items.title: Session Hijacking Vulnerability
items.summary: This vulnerability allows attackers to steal user sessions, potentially leading to unauthorized access and account takeover.

items.id: No specific CVE (Backdoor in ecommerce components)
items.title: Backdoor found in popular ecommerce components via supply chain attack
items.summary: Multiple vendors were affected by a coordinated supply chain attack, injecting a backdoor into 21 applications. The malware, injected years ago, became active recently.

items.title: Criminals mass-scanning for defunct.dat files containing GSocket backdoor keys
items.summary: Criminals are actively mass-scanning for `defunct.dat` files which contain GSocket backdoor keys, with dozens of infected stores already identified.
